# Lab 9: SQL Exercises

## Setup

Install and load required packages:

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# Install packages if needed
# install.packages("RSQLite")
# install.packages("DBI")

library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)
```

Create an in-memory SQLite database and load the data:

```{r}
# Create in-memory SQLite connection
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), ":memory:")

doctor <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmcable/BIOSTAT620W26/main/data/hospital/doctor.csv")
visit <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmcable/BIOSTAT620W26/main/data/hospital/visit.csv")
patient <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmcable/BIOSTAT620W26/main/data/hospital/patient.csv")
payment <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmcable/BIOSTAT620W26/main/data/hospital/payment.csv")


# Load tables into the database
dbWriteTable(con, "doctor", doctor, overwrite = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con, "patient", patient, overwrite = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con, "visit", visit, overwrite = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(con, "payment", payment, overwrite = TRUE)

dbListTables(con)
```

## Exercise 1

```{r}
query1 <- "
  SELECT doctor_id, first_name, last_name
  FROM doctor
  ORDER BY last_name, first_name
"
result1 <- dbGetQuery(con, query1)
head(result1, 10)
```

## Exercise 2

```{r}
query2 <- "
  SELECT doctor_id, first_name, last_name
  FROM doctor
  WHERE last_name IN ('WILLIAMS', 'DAVIS')
  ORDER BY last_name, first_name
"
result2 <- dbGetQuery(con, query2)
result2
```

## Exercise 3

```{r}

  SELECT patient_id, visit_start_date
  FROM visit

"
result3 <- dbGetQuery(con, query3)
head(result3)
```

## Exercise 4

### 4.1

```{r}
query4.1 <- "
  SELECT payment_id, amount
  FROM payment
  WHERE amount IN (199, 799, 999)
  ORDER BY amount
"
result4.1 <- dbGetQuery(con, query4.1)
head(result4.1)
```

### 4.2

```{r}
query4.2 <- "
  SELECT payment_id, amount
  FROM payment
  WHERE amount > 500
  ORDER BY amount DESC
"
result4.2 <- dbGetQuery(con, query4.2)
head(result4.2)
```

### 4.3

```{r}
query4.3 <- "
  SELECT payment_id, amount
  FROM payment
  WHERE amount BETWEEN 500 AND 800
  ORDER BY amount
"
result4.3 <- dbGetQuery(con, query4.3)
head(result4.3)
```

## Exercise 5

```{r}
query5 <- "
  SELECT p.payment_id, p.amount, pt.patient_id, pt.last_name
  FROM payment p
  INNER JOIN patient pt ON p.patient_id = pt.patient_id
  WHERE pt.last_name = 'DAVIS'
  ORDER BY p.amount
"
result5 <- dbGetQuery(con, query5)
head(result5, 10)
```

## Exercise 6

### 6.1

```{r}
query6.1 <- "
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM visit
"
result6.1 <- dbGetQuery(con, query6.1)
result6.1
```

### 6.2

```{r}
query6.2 <- "
  SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) as visit_count
  FROM visit
  GROUP BY patient_id
  ORDER BY visit_count
"
result6.2 <- dbGetQuery(con, query6.2)
head(result6.2, 10)
```

### 6.3

```{r}
query6.3 <- "
  SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) as visit_count
  FROM visit
  GROUP BY patient_id
  ORDER BY visit_count DESC
"
result6.3 <- dbGetQuery(con, query6.3)
head(result6.3, 10)
```

### 6.4

```{r}
query6.4 <- "
  SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) as visit_count
  FROM visit
  GROUP BY patient_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 40
  ORDER BY visit_count DESC
"
result6.4 <- dbGetQuery(con, query6.4)
result6.4
```

## Exercise 7

```{r}
query7 <- "
  SELECT
    MAX(amount) as max_amount,
    MIN(amount) as min_amount,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount,
    SUM(amount) as total_amount
  FROM payment
"
result7 <- dbGetQuery(con, query7)
result7
```

### 7.1

```{r}
query7.1 <- "
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    COUNT(*) as payment_count,
    MAX(amount) as max_amount,
    MIN(amount) as min_amount,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount,
    SUM(amount) as total_amount
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY patient_id
  ORDER BY payment_count DESC
"
result7.1 <- dbGetQuery(con, query7.1)
head(result7.1, 10)
```

### 7.2

```{r}
query7.2 <- "
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    COUNT(*) as payment_count,
    MAX(amount) as max_amount,
    MIN(amount) as min_amount,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount,
    SUM(amount) as total_amount
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY patient_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
  ORDER BY payment_count DESC
"
result7.2 <- dbGetQuery(con, query7.2)
head(result7.2, 10)
```

## Exercise 8

### 8.1

```{r}
query8.1 <- "
  SELECT
    d.doctor_id,
    d.first_name,
    d.last_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_visits,
    AVG(julianday(v.visit_end_date) - julianday(v.visit_start_date)) as avg_visit_length
  FROM doctor d
  INNER JOIN visit v ON d.doctor_id = v.doctor_id
  GROUP BY d.doctor_id, d.first_name, d.last_name
  ORDER BY avg_visit_length DESC
"
result8.1 <- dbGetQuery(con, query8.1)
head(result8.1, 10)
```

### 8.2

```{r}
## Shortest
query8.2 <- "
  SELECT
    d.doctor_id,
    d.first_name,
    d.last_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_visits,
    AVG(julianday(v.visit_end_date) - julianday(v.visit_start_date)) as avg_visit_length
  FROM doctor d
  INNER JOIN visit v ON d.doctor_id = v.doctor_id
  GROUP BY d.doctor_id, d.first_name, d.last_name
  ORDER BY avg_visit_length
  LIMIT 5
"
result8.2 <- dbGetQuery(con, query8.2)
result8.2
```
```{r}
## Longest
query8.2_L <- "
  SELECT
    d.doctor_id,
    d.first_name,
    d.last_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_visits,
    AVG(julianday(v.visit_end_date) - julianday(v.visit_start_date)) as avg_visit_length
  FROM doctor d
  INNER JOIN visit v ON d.doctor_id = v.doctor_id
  GROUP BY d.doctor_id, d.first_name, d.last_name
  ORDER BY avg_visit_length DESC
  LIMIT 5
"
result8.2_L <- dbGetQuery(con, query8.2_L)
result8.2_L
```
